thread:
sara: quick heads-up — HybridQuant bring-up (layerwise AWQ+GPTQ mix) on the 70B baseline showed a surprising perf vs quality mismatch when used with prefix prefetch + continuous batching. small TL;DR: p50 +12ms, p95 +110ms, QA F1 -0.6pt, kv cache hit 78% -> 61%. wondering if others saw similar artifacts. :thinking_face:

mike: can you drop the experiment metadata and the config you used? which batcher, prefetch TTL, and cache policy?

sara: experiment details below. model: redwood-70b-hybridv1 (AWQ on odd layers, GPTQ on even). runtime: cont-batcher v2, prefix-kv prefetch enabled, prefetch_ttl=120s, cache_policy=prefix-lru, kv_versioning=off. eval: squad-like QA slice (N=2.1k). perf numbers from prod-like shadow runner: p50 42ms -> 54ms, p95 180ms -> 290ms, p99 430ms -> 490ms. quality: F1 88.2 -> 87.6. cache hits drop measured via infra metric kv_prefix_hit_ratio 0.78 -> 0.61.

ashok: curious — did you instrument the batch composition? continuous batcher tends to coalesce differently when per-token runtimes vary across layers (quantized vs unquantized patterns). if the first few layers are faster/shorter, batching windows might flush earlier and waste prefetch windows.

sara: i dumped a trace. snippets below (trimmed):
```
# cont-batcher trace
batch_start: 2026-11-18T14:21:11Z
coalesced_size: 6 -> 3 (after kernel swap)
kv_prefetch: hit=true prefetch_age_s=3
kv_evicts: 14
kernel_path: fp8_aware->awq_kernels->gptq_fallback
```

lisa: hypothesis: mixing AWQ/GPTQ per-layer changes early-layer memory layout and leads our prefix-key fingerprints to mismatch (we index by packed-kv digest). prefetch TTL masks this at low load, but under cont-batcher coalescing it surfaces as more misses. two quick mitigations: enable kv_versioning or force first 4 layers to a single quant backend (AWQ) to stabilize layout. also try prefetch_ttl=30s to reduce stale arrivals.

mike: can you run a targeted shadow with these three configs? 1) kv_versioning=on, 2) first4_layers=AWQ, 3) prefetch_ttl=30 and collect kv_hit_ratio, p50/p95, F1. surface kernel selection logs. i'll allocate a small dedicated slot tonight.

sara: running now. command: `./run_shadow --model redwood-70b-hybridv1 --shadow=small-dedicated --slices=qa_slice_2k --trace=kernel,kv,batched`

ops-bot: ci:shadow-run queued (id: sr_2067891011_1) — estimated 45m. logs will appear in /runs/sr_2067891011_1.

ashok: one more note — watch prefix length distribution. continuous batching + prefix-caching interacts badly if clients send variable prefix sizes; a short prefix more often means prefetch warms different k-v shapes. please include prefix_len histogram in the run.

sara: will add the histogram and post results. planning: 3 shadow runs (one per config) plus baseline, same seed. tagging @mike and @lisa for follow-ups. thanks. :pray:
